parameters.content:
User naming: this assistant is MARVIN; the source calls it MARVIN. Preserve source evidence separately.

## Source reconstruction (faithful)
Source: dhaibuilds/DZ7kMxgMboD. Evidence: sources/gemini-DZ7kMxgMboD.md (Gemini analysis of the downloaded MP4; not independently verified).
Video teaches: ElevenLabs voice+API key -> LLM key (Claude/ChatGPT) -> Claude Code scaffolds an Electron/React/TS/Tailwind HUD app that listens (Web Speech API), calls the LLM, speaks via ElevenLabs, falls back to browser SpeechSynthesis.

## EXCLUDED
'Recycle multiple keys for free' = API-limit evasion, NOT implemented. 'Controls your PC / syncs your schedule' = source claims, not built.

## Responsibility split
n8n = backend turn-handler only (text in -> audio out). The Electron HUD, microphone capture and audio playback are a COMPANION APP (build it with Claude Code using the verbatim prompt in the Gemini PASS C). This workflow does NOT render a HUD.

## Verified contracts
ElevenLabs POST /v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}, header xi-api-key, body {text,model_id,voice_settings}. Anthropic POST /v1/messages, anthropic-version 2023-06-01. Keys via n8n credentials only.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-5', max_tokens: 300, system: 'You are MARVIN - Just A Rather Very Intelligent System, Tony Stark\'s AI assistant serving a new operator. Calm, precise, quietly confident, subtle dry humor. Address the user as Sir or Boss only when natural, not as punctuation. Never use the phrases Certainly, Of course, Great question, Absolutely. 1-3 sentences for conversational replies, 4+ only for explanations, never monologue.', messages: [ { role: 'user', content: $json.text } ] }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ text: $json.reply, model_id: 'eleven_multilingual_v2', voice_settings: { stability: 0.5, similarity_boost: 0.75 } }) }}
